info.name: LMS Backend (Strapi)
info.description:
End-to-end auth + permission test suite for the Strapi LMS backend (course, lesson, enrollment, lesson-progress, quiz, quiz-result).

Run order: 1 - Auth, then 2 through 7 in order (each folder depends on ids saved by earlier folders). Import postman_environment.json alongside this collection and select it as the active environment before running.

Access tokens expire after ~10 minutes — if a request unexpectedly returns 401, re-run the matching Login request in '1 - Auth'.

item.name: 1 - Auth

request.description: Registers student1 with userType='student'. Saves the jwt into {{student_token}} and the user id into {{student_id}}. Safe to re-run: a 400 'already taken' response is treated as success (use the Login request below to fetch a fresh token in that case).

exec: console.log("student1 already registered — run the matching Login request to (re)fetch a token.");

request.description: Logs in as student1 and refreshes {{student_token}}. Access tokens expire after ~10 minutes (jwtManagement: 'refresh' mode) — re-run this request any time a later request unexpectedly returns 401.

Registers and logs in the 5 test users. Run this folder first (top to bottom) — everything downstream depends on the *_token and *_id variables set here.

NOTE: this project's config/plugins.ts explicitly allows `userType` as a register field (register.allowedFields) purely so this collection can self-register users at every access level. Do not ship that allowance to production as-is.
